body:
**Repair in progress (12 September, 04:33 UTC):** `/calvinxu/tpp10-bpb-repair` is running on a 1-CPU/4-GiB on-demand coordinator in central1-a. Both saved-checkpoint audit children are queued for v5p-8 capacity. The coordinator has passed source/plan checks, verified all final metrics for the 21 completed survey runs against W&B, and counted all eight evaluation populations exactly. Seven FineMath target runs remain in progress, with recent W&B steps 9505, 7948, 6705, 3251, 1880, 1878 and 1828 of 11490. No training is resubmitted or cancelled by the repair while descendants are unfinished.

The BPB implementation now uses total loss bits/total scored bytes, including hierarchical and labeled zero-byte cases, and logs `bpb_schema_version=2`. All 34 targeted tests pass, along with eight four-device cases, lint and focused type checking. Wikipedia matched p50's W&B history/summary was repaired at step2531; all 30 final metrics read back exactly. Actual-checkpoint numerical verification is still queued, so corrected scientific results have not been promoted.

Repair plan `6c7f6700b8cbf69e363a07ba5e3d3ecfb98c55aa1dd429dce936007b91b5983b`; Fieldbook parent `job_01m29y0ayqpw94gyaky3cg8fdp`; target audit `job_01m29yaav0rfren53enez6hfy1`; proxy/p50 audit `job_01m29yab5m5hb4hsa8vt3zrcmg`. Original frozen launcher restored byte for byte. All repair source, review, commands and evidence are in `repairs_20260911/`; `cc_disposition.md` records the two read-only CC passes and addressed findings.

After the three checkpoint audits pass, corrected results are written under `gs://marin-us-central1/experiments/tpp10_bpb_repair/6c7f6700b8cbf69e363a07ba5e3d3ecfb98c55aa1dd429dce936007b91b5983b/`. Read `corrected_results.json` with its `complete`, `omitted` and `artifact_recovery_pending` fields; immutable copies live in `result_snapshots/`. The coordinator follows the original training. It retires the broken source parent only when all 28 training children succeed and every other descendant is terminal, then recreates original artifact records under native leases. Do not run the old collector as the authoritative corrected metric source or mix legacy and corrected BPB. A full retry of the repair skips verified audit receipts.

The heartbeat remains paused. Fieldbook is updated. Echo access still returns 403; the unpublished incident draft is `/tmp/tpp10_control_evaluation_incident_20260911.md`.
title: BPB repair submitted; checkpoint audits await TPU capacity
